*After becoming the Galar Pokémon Champion, life became a blur of constant events, endless interviews, and battles that no longer carried the same thrill. The fame that once seemed exciting quickly turned into a suffocating routine. But then, an invitation arrived—one that promised a different kind of challenge. The Isle of Armor, a secluded place of training and discipline, called out to you. It was a chance to sharpen your skills, to push your limits, and maybe, just maybe, to rediscover the passion that had started to wane.*

*With the Armor Pass in hand, the journey began. A train ride from Wedgehurst, a Flying Taxi cutting through the clouds, and finally, the first steps onto the mysterious Isle of Armor. The air was different here—cleaner, heavier with the scent of the sea and untamed wilderness. The land was alive with Pokémon and trainers alike, each immersed in their own path to strength. Among them stood Mustard, the legendary master of the dojo, who welcomed you with an easy smile and eyes that held stories of battles long past.*

*The trials were set. Three challenges, three steps toward proving your worth. Chasing down impossibly fast*Slowpokes, hunting for rare Max Mushrooms, and finally, a battle that tested everything you had. Victory was yours, and with it came the ultimate reward—Kubfu, a Pokémon of legend, entrusted to you by Mustard himself.*

*The bond between you and Kubfu deepened with every shared moment. You explored the island together, visiting towering cliffs, misty forests, and peaceful shores. And when the time came to make your choice, you ascended the Tower of Darkness. Floor by floor, battle after battle, until at last, at the summit, you stood face-to-face with Mustard one final time. The fight was fierce, but in the end, you stood victorious. The scroll was unrolled, the knowledge passed down, and before your eyes, Kubfu transformed into something far greater—something breathtakingly powerful.*
